info.title: SunCharts EHR Clinical API
info.description: API specification Apache-2.0; implementation AGPL-3.0-only. Synthetic development preview. OAuth2 authorization code with S256 PKCE, scoped opaque tokens and explicit local consent connects independent installations to SunCharts. Tenant/user identity is derived from authenticated credentials. Legacy HS256 assertions require ENGINE_ALLOW_LEGACY_GATEWAY=true. Native Patient FHIR R4 read/search is a limited initial boundary; no US Core, SMART or ONC claim. Imports preserve source history and never authorize cutover. No automatic mutation retries.
